name: Workspace Shell
description: A container-responsive app frame: a navigation rail with a travelling selection, compact page header, actions and retained views that keep their drafts.

props.name: brand
props.description: Workspace identity. Long identities truncate within the rail without expanding narrow layouts.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small mono label above the page heading: the area of the product.

props.name: title
props.description: Page heading. Change it per view; the new heading fades in.

props.name: links
props.description: Unique IDs, labels and real routes or section anchors, each with an optional 16px `icon` and a `badge` count.

props.name: actions
props.description: Host-owned controls beside the heading. Header controls stack above the content so dropdowns remain reachable.

props.name: children
props.description: The page panels, each retaining its own API.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Optional mono heading above the rail's links, such as "Channels".

props.name: railFooter
props.description: Pinned to the bottom of the navigation rail in wide containers: an account, a plan or a sync status.

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of the selection mark in the rail and the compact tab strip. Also exposed to children as `--ws-accent`.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled selected view. Pair with onNavigate for real tab navigation; omit both for normal route or anchor links.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Turns navigation into keyboard-accessible tabs. The host changes activeId and the corresponding WorkspacePanels view.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Host classes on the scrolling content pane. A fixed-height shell keeps navigation and header in place.
